lines.translation: Such is he, the Fortunate One, the Worthy One, the Perfect Sambuddha,
the one endowed with understanding and good conduct, the Happy One, the one who understands the worlds,

lines.text: Anuttaro purisadammasārathi, satthā devamanussānaṃ, buddho, bhagavāti.
lines.roman: Anuttaro purisadammasārathi, satthā devamanussānaṃ, buddho, bhagavāti.
lines.translation: unexcelled trainer of those who can be tamed, teacher of devas & human beings; awakened; blessed.
The Dhamma has been well-proclaimed by the Fortunate One:
to be seen here & now, timeless, inviting all to come & see,
pertinent, to be seen by the observant for themselves.
The Fortunate One’s Saṅgha of disciples are good in their practice:
the Fortunate One’s Saṅgha of disciples are upright in their practice,
the Fortunate One’s Saṅgha of disciples are systematic in their practice,
the Fortunate One’s Saṅgha of disciples are correct in their practice,
that is to say, the four pairs of persons, the eight individual persons,
this is the Fortunate One’s Saṅgha of disciples,
worthy of gifts, worthy of hospitality, worthy of offerings, worthy of respect,
they are an unsurpassed field of merit for the world.

title: Verses in Celebration of the Buddha

lines.translation: Come now, let us recite praise of the Buddha:
The Buddha has noble virtues, such as being Worthy and so forth,
together with pure higher knowledges and compassion,
the one who awakens good people like the sun (awakens) the lotus,
I worship that passionless, Victorious Lord with my head.
The Buddha, who is the supreme refuge for all living beings,
I recall first in this place, I worship him with my head,

lines.text: Buddhassāhasmi dāso va, buddho me sāmikissaro,
lines.roman: Buddhassāhasmi dāso va, buddho me sāmikissaro,

lines.text: Buddho dukkhassa ghātā ca vidhātā ca hitassa me,
lines.roman: Buddho dukkhassa ghātā ca vidhātā ca hitassa me,
lines.translation: The Buddha is a destroyer of suffering, a provider (of solace) and he benefits me.

lines.text: Natthi me saraṇaṃ aññaṃ, buddho me saraṇaṃ varaṃ,
lines.roman: Natthi me saraṇaṃ aññaṃ, buddho me saraṇaṃ varaṃ,
lines.translation: For me there is no other refuge, for me the Buddha is the best refuge!
By this declaration of the truth may the Teacher’s dispensation prosper.

lines.text: Buddhaṃ me vandamānena, yaṃ puññaṃ pasutaṃ idha,
lines.roman: Buddhaṃ me vandamānena, yaṃ puññaṃ pasutaṃ idha,

lines.text: Sabbepi antarāyā me, māhesuṃ tassa tejasā.
lines.roman: Sabbepi antarāyā me, māhesuṃ tassa tejasā.
lines.translation: through the power of that, may there be no dangers for me.
By body, by speech or by mind,
whatever bad deeds were done by me regarding the Buddha,
may the Buddha accept my confession,
for my restraint in the future regarding the Buddha.

meta.description: Celebratory verses praising the Buddha, ending with dedication of body and life to the Buddha and an acknowledgement of faults by body, speech, or mind.

lines.text: Bāhuṃ sahassamabhinimmitasāvudhantaṃ, Girīmekhalaṃ uditaghorasasenamāraṃ, Dānādidhammavidhinā jitavā munindo, Tantejasā bhavatu te jayamaṅgalāni.
lines.roman: Bāhuṃ sahassamabhinimmitasāvudhantaṃ, Girīmekhalaṃ uditaghorasasenamāraṃ, Dānādidhammavidhinā jitavā munindo, Tantejasā bhavatu te jayamaṅgalāni.

lines.text: Mārātirekamabhipujjhitasabbarattiṃ, Ghorampanāravakamakkhamathaddhayakkhaṃ, Khantīsudantavidhinā jitavā munindo, Tantejasā bhavatu te jayamaṅgalāni.

lines.text: Nāḷāgiriṃ gajavaraṃ atimattabhūtaṃ, Dāvaggicakkamasanīva sudāruṇantaṃ, Mettambusekavidhinā jitavā munindo, Tantejasā bhavatu te jayamaṅgalāni.
lines.roman: Nāḷāgiriṃ gajavaraṃ atimattabhūtaṃ, Dāvaggicakkamasanīva sudāruṇantaṃ, Mettambusekavidhinā jitavā munindo, Tantejasā bhavatu te jayamaṅgalāni.

lines.text: Ukkhittakhaggamatihatthasudāruṇantaṃ, Dhāvantiyojanapathaṅgulimālavantaṃ, Iddhībhisaṅkhatamano jitavā munindo, Tantejasā bhavatu te jayamaṅgalāni.
lines.roman: Ukkhittakhaggamatihatthasudāruṇantaṃ, Dhāvantiyojanapathaṅgulimālavantaṃ, Iddhībhisaṅkhatamano jitavā munindo, Tantejasā bhavatu te jayamaṅgalāni.

lines.text: Katvāna kaṭṭhamudaraṃ iva gabbhinīyā, Ciñcāya duṭṭhavacanaṃ janakāyamajjhe, Santena somavidhinā jitavā munindo, Tantejasā bhavatu te jayamaṅgalāni.
lines.roman: Katvāna kaṭṭhamudaraṃ iva gabbhinīyā, Ciñcāya duṭṭhavacanaṃ janakāyamajjhe, Santena somavidhinā jitavā munindo, Tantejasā bhavatu te jayamaṅgalāni.

lines.text: Saccaṃ vihāya matisaccakavādaketuṃ, Vādābhirohitamanaṃ atiandhabhūtaṃ, Paññāpadīpajalito jitavā munindo, Tantejasā bhavatu te jayamaṅgalāni.

lines.text: Duggāhadiṭṭhibhujagena sudaṭṭhahatthaṃ, Brahmaṃ visuddhijutimiddhibakābhidhānaṃ, Ñāṇāgadena vidhinā jitavā munindo, Tantejasā bhavatu te jayamaṅgalāni.

title: Salutation to the Triple Gem and Chastened Dispassion

lines.text: Handa mayaṃ ratanattayappaṇāmagāthāyo ceva saṃvegavatthuparidīpakapāṭhañca bhaṇāma se.
lines.roman: Handa mayaṃ ratanattayappaṇāmagāthāyo ceva saṃvegavatthuparidīpakapāṭhañca bhaṇāma se.
lines.translation: Now let us recite the stanzas in salutation to the Triple Gem together with the passage on the topics inspiring a sense of chastened dispassion:
The Buddha, who is very pure, with great ocean-like compassion,
he who has the perpetual, pure and noble eye of knowledge,
who destroys the wickedness and corruptions of the world:
with devotion I worship the Buddha.
The Dhamma of the Teacher, like a lamp,
which is split into Path, Fruit and the Deathless,
which is super-mundane, and explains that goal:
with devotion I worship that Dhamma.
The Saṅgha, known as a field better than the best field,
who have seen peace, and awakened like the Happy One,
who have abandoned wavering, are Noble and wise:
with devotion I worship that Saṅgha.

lines.translation: With proper discernment I make use of the robe,
simply to counteract the cold,
to counteract the heat,
to ward off contact with gadflies, mosquitoes, wind, the heat (of the sun), and creeping things,
only as a cover for the shameful parts.
With proper discernment I make use of almsfood,
and so I will get rid of any old feeling,
and not produce any new feeling,

lines.text: Yātrā ca me bhavissati anavajjatā ca phāsuvihāro cāti.

only to ward off oppressive feelings that have arisen
and at least be free from oppression.

lines.translation: He who has attained the Truth, the Worthy One, Rightly Self-awakened,
After hearing the Dhamma, we understand it thus:
Birth is suffering
also old age is suffering
also death is suffering
also grief, lamentation, pain, sorrow, and despair, is suffering,
also being joined to what is not liked is suffering,
also being parted from what is liked is suffering,
also not to obtain that which one longs for is suffering,
in brief, the five components (of mind and body) that provide fuel for attachment are suffering.
They are as follows:
The bodily-form component that provides fuel for attachment,
the feelings component that provides fuel for attachment,
the perceptions component that provides fuel for attachment,
the volitions component that provides fuel for attachment,
the consciousness component that provides fuel for attachment.
guided his disciples many times,

lines.text: Yāvakīvañca me bhikkhave imesu catūsu ariyasaccesu evaṃ tiparivaṭṭaṃ dvādasākāraṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ na suvisuddhaṃ ahosi,
lines.roman: Yāvakīvañca me bhikkhave imesu catūsu ariyasaccesu evaṃ tiparivaṭṭaṃ dvādasākāraṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ na suvisuddhaṃ ahosi,

lines.text: Neva tāvāhaṃ bhikkhave sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake, sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya, anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho paccaññāsiṃ.
lines.roman: Neva tāvāhaṃ bhikkhave sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake, sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya, anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho paccaññāsiṃ.

lines.text: Yato ca kho me bhikkhave imesu catūsu ariyasaccesu evaṃ tiparivaṭṭaṃ dvādasākāraṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ suvisuddhaṃ ahosi,
lines.roman: Yato ca kho me bhikkhave imesu catūsu ariyasaccesu evaṃ tiparivaṭṭaṃ dvādasākāraṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ suvisuddhaṃ ahosi,

lines.text: Athāhaṃ bhikkhave sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake, sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya, anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho paccaññāsiṃ.

lines.text: Ñāṇañca pana me dassanaṃ udapādi, akuppā me vimutti, ayamantimā jāti, natthidāni punabbhavoti.
lines.roman: Ñāṇañca pana me dassanaṃ udapādi, akuppā me vimutti, ayamantimā jāti, natthidāni punabbhavoti.

lines.text: Idamavoca bhagavā. attamanā pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanduṃ.
lines.roman: Idamavoca bhagavā. attamanā pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanduṃ.

lines.text: Imasmiñca pana veyyākaraṇasmiṃ bhaññamāne āyasmato koṇḍaññassa virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi,
lines.roman: Imasmiñca pana veyyākaraṇasmiṃ bhaññamāne āyasmato koṇḍaññassa virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi,

lines.text: Yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhammanti.
lines.roman: Yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhammanti.

lines.text: Pavattite ca bhagavatā dhammacakke bhummā devā saddamanussāvesuṃ,
lines.roman: Pavattite ca bhagavatā dhammacakke bhummā devā saddamanussāvesuṃ,

lines.text: Etaṃ bhagavatā bārāṇasiyaṃ isipatane migadāye anuttaraṃ dhammacakkaṃ pavattitaṃ,
lines.roman: Etaṃ bhagavatā bārāṇasiyaṃ isipatane migadāye anuttaraṃ dhammacakkaṃ pavattitaṃ,

lines.text: Appativattiyaṃ samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā mārena vā brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasminti.
lines.roman: Appativattiyaṃ samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā mārena vā brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasminti.

lines.text: Nimmānaratīnaṃ devānaṃ saddaṃ sutvā paranimmitavasavattī devā saddamanussāvesuṃ...

lines.roman: Paranimmitavasavattīnaṃ devānaṃ saddaṃ sutvā brahmakāyikā devā saddamanussāvesuṃ,

lines.text: Itiha tena khaṇena tena muhuttena yāva brahmalokā saddo abbhuggacchi.
lines.roman: Itiha tena khaṇena tena muhuttena yāva brahmalokā saddo abbhuggacchi.

lines.text: Ayañca dasasahassī lokadhātu saṅkampi sampakampi sampavedhi,
lines.roman: Ayañca dasasahassī lokadhātu saṅkampi sampakampi sampavedhi,

lines.text: Appamāṇo ca uḷāro obhāso loke pāturahosi, atikkamma devānaṃ devānubhāvaṃ.
lines.roman: Appamāṇo ca uḷāro obhāso loke pāturahosi, atikkamma devānaṃ devānubhāvaṃ.

lines.text: Atha kho bhagavā udānaṃ udānesi, aññāsi vata bho koṇḍañño, aññāsi vata bho koṇḍaññoti,
lines.roman: Atha kho bhagavā udānaṃ udānesi, aññāsi vata bho koṇḍañño, aññāsi vata bho koṇḍaññoti,

lines.text: Itihidaṃ āyasmato koṇḍaññassa aññākoṇḍaññotveva nāmaṃ ahosīti.
lines.roman: Itihidaṃ āyasmato koṇḍaññassa aññākoṇḍaññotveva nāmaṃ ahosīti.
